status_note: Still open on main (a4d8e00342d0): [`functions_arithmetic_decimal.yaml` L49-L87](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/blob/a4d8e00342d0/extensions/functions_arithmetic_decimal.yaml#L49-L87) (and `add`/`subtract` L8-L47) give result types and `overflow` only, with no rounding. Existing issue: [#1224](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/issues/1224) asks exactly this for the precision-38 borrow; divide's always-inexact result and casts between scales are not in it. Related: [#1318](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/issues/1318) (decimal handling, vbarua), [#1223](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/pull/1223), [#1274](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/pull/1274).
summary: `functions_arithmetic_decimal.yaml` gives each function's result type, and nothing about how a result with more digits than the result's scale is rounded: always for `divide`, and for `add`, `subtract`, `multiply` when the precision passes 38 and the scale is borrowed. Casts between decimal scales (`specialized_record_expressions.md`) leave it open too. Engines round half to even (Polars) or half away from zero (DuckDB).
repro: `multiply(DECIMAL<10,2> 0.05, DECIMAL<10,1> 0.5)` at a result scale of 2 (an engine's own result type, or a cast to `DECIMAL<10,2>`): Polars 2.1.0 gives 0.02, half away from zero gives 0.03. `divide(DECIMAL<10,2> 1.00, DECIMAL<10,0> 8)` at scale 2: 0.12 or 0.13.
handling: The core's `decimal_rescale` option allows `TIE_AWAY_FROM_ZERO`, `TIE_TO_EVEN` and `TRUNCATE` (docs/core-semantics.md); the reference rounds half away from zero. Decimal division is refused in every profile until #27.
Could be expressed as: a `rounding` option on the decimal functions and casts, with the values of `round`'s.
